description: This file declares the PrimaryKeyBuilder class used for creating and managing TPM keys within the Android Open Source Project's secure environment module. It includes member functions for setting up different types of keys and creating TPM objects, as well as factory functions for key creation strategies.

classes.name: PrimaryKeyBuilder
classes.description: A class for constructing TPM primary keys, including methods for configuring key types and creating TPM objects.

methods.description: Sets unique data used in key creation.
